What’s established is pretty limited but suggestive:

- There’s an unidentified site referred to as a “tower where the voices are coming from.” Lysandra claims she knows where it is.
- While seemingly under a cult-like influence (shimmery eyes, mumbling), she drew a detailed top-down blueprint of this tower.
- The drawing is described as well done, but no matching known location has been identified yet.
- After being brought out of the state, Lysandra is confused and only remembers “voices in the dark” after the group entered the forest.
- The site is currently uncatalogued (“Unknown Sites / Voices Tower”), and even its canonical placement in the setting is still an open question.

So: a likely real location, tied to the voices and possible cult influence, with a concrete map—but no confirmed place in the world yet.
